gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that {@link StringTokenizer#getCSVInstance(String)} and {@link StringTokenizer#getCSVInstance(char[])} correctly parse the simple, comma-separated input {
ADDED i2: Simple comma-separated input that should yield the tokens "A", "b", "c".
ADDED i3: Verifies that a freshly created tokenizer is a distinct, independent instance rather than one of the shared CSV/TSV prototypes.
ADDED i4: Drives a tokenizer that is expected to produce exactly the tokens "A", "b", "c", checking the values and iteration indices while walking forwards to the end and
ADDED i5: Before reading anything: positioned before the first token.
ADDED i6: Walk forwards through all three tokens.
ADDED i7: Past the last token: no more tokens, index stays at the end.
ADDED i8: Walk backwards through all three tokens.
ADDED i9: Before the first token again: no previous token available.
ADDED i10: The String and char[] factory methods must behave identically.
